task: Add CuMetal D50 detection, D51 clang/JIT CUDA smoke harness and Phase 2 AOT/JIT compatibility matrix + NVML shim measurements (#84), add D52 scheduling-only simulated NVIDIA GPU on the managed Colima k3s node, pin k3s API port 36443 with make cluster-repair (D1), and correct stale Phase 3 thermal/GPU architecture notes.

events.summary: Host ML/CuMetal (#84): read-only D50 probe (services/cumetal.rs, get_cumetal_status, CumetalCard), D51 clang registration/JIT smoke harness (services/cumetal/harness.rs, run_cumetal_smoke, CumetalSmokeCard, scripts/cumetal/smoke/*.cu, process::external_command_at, gpu_benchmark::check_workloads_for), and Phase 2 14-probe matrix + NVML shim measurements (scripts/cumetal/matrix/*, docs/20). K8s simulated GPU (D52): scripts/k8s/simulated-gpu.sh + test_simulated_gpu.sh + Makefile sim-gpu-* targets (managed Colima context only, no device passthrough). Colima k3s port (D1): scripts/colima-k3s-port.txt (36443) shared by Makefile cluster-up and colima::start_cluster, plus scripts/k8s/repair-k3s-cred-port.sh + test_repair_k3s_cred_port.sh (make cluster-repair). Docs: docs/04 Phase 3 thermal/GPU drift corrected, D1/D50/D51/D52 and mistakes-log updated.

During live cluster verification, Colima 0.10.3 reused its persisted /etc/colima/colima.json k3s_listen_port while k3s kept bootstrap-only /var/lib/rancher/k3s/server/cred/*.kubeconfig pointing at an older port, causing controller-manager connection-refused errors and a k3s crash loop (NRestarts=246). Separately, without Xcode MetalToolchain, cumetal doctor and cumetalc AOT exited 1 while clang CUDA JIT worked; NVML shim returned NOT_SUPPORTED for utilization/temp/power/clocks and reported machine RAM for memory; docs/04 still described Phase 3 thermal/GPU as unstarted; and GPT critic reviews (Luna/Sol) surfaced edge cases in script validation, cleanup, and harness handling.

Pinned --k3s-listen-port 36443 from scripts/colima-k3s-port.txt across Makefile and start_cluster (guarded by makefile_and_start_cluster_share_the_k3s_port_source) and added repair-k3s-cred-port.sh to rewrite cred kubeconfigs to the measured apiserver --secure-port and verify 30s stability. Implemented D50/D51 fail-closed provenance smoke harness, Phase 2 AOT/JIT matrix, and D52 scheduling-only simulated-gpu.sh with Colima-context enforcement and cleanup traps; resolved all GPT critic findings (Luna/Sol) and aligned docs/04 with shipped D2/D28/D40.

make cluster-repair succeeded on the live Colima VM (cred kubeconfigs rewritten, k3s active with NRestarts unchanged over 30s, node Ready) and the VM restarted twice afterward without a crash loop. Hermetic stub suites test_repair_k3s_cred_port.sh and test_simulated_gpu.sh passed, and cargo test --lib passed 494 Rust tests including CuMetal probe/harness unit tests and the k3s port drift test after applying the Luna/Sol review fixes.

make verify exited 0 (cargo test 494 passed, Python unittests, airgap/k8s shell tests, cargo fmt --check, clippy -D warnings, tsc --noEmit, check_ipc_types.py, DESIGN.md lint, license-check, pnpm build). On-device 2026-11-08: D51 live smoke returned all_passed=true with device=apple_gpu on both JIT and AOT paths and cumetal doctor exited 0 after MetalToolchain install; make sim-gpu-verify on colima-kubemetal observed the 1-GPU pod Running, the N+1 pod Pending (Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu), and zero leftover pods after cleanup.

Fresh VM creation via colima start --k3s-listen-port 36443 was not exercised (existing VM was migrated via /etc/colima/colima.json + make cluster-repair). D52 simulated GPU advertises scheduling capacity only with no device passthrough, and persistence across kubelet/k3s re-registration remains unverified. D51 Apple-GPU provenance relies on CuMetal's self-reported CUMETAL_PROVENANCE lines without an independent ioreg delta, and the Phase 2 matrix did not hit unavailable/failed branches on the 14 live probes.

D50/D51 CuMetal detection and smoke harness, Phase 2 matrix + NVML findings (#84), D52 simulated GPU scheduling, D1 k3s port pin + cluster-repair, and docs/04 Phase 3 corrections are verified across make verify (494 Rust tests) and live macOS/Colima runtime checks within the limits noted in e6.
Complete and verified across hermetic unit/lint/build gates (make verify, 494 Rust tests) and live host CuMetal (JIT + AOT) and Colima k3s (cluster-repair, sim-gpu-verify) checks.
